job: Ransomware attack on hospital networks (real Sarvam 30B run)

fields.label: Post 1
fields.text: A ransomware group called NightLedger is encrypting patient-record and billing systems at hospitals. This is a high-severity attack on critical healthcare infrastructure. #CyberSecurity

fields.label: Post 2
fields.text: The attack exploits an unpatched remote-access gateway, causing disruption at 42 hospitals across five states. We are working to mitigate the threat. #Healthcare

fields.label: Post 3
fields.text: Affected hospitals are advised to apply the vendor patch immediately, block attacker IP addresses, and reset all remote-access passwords. Do not pay the ransom. #IncidentResponse

fields.label: Paragraph 1
fields.text: A recent attack by the ransomware group 'NightLedger' is disrupting patient-record and billing systems at 42 hospitals across five states. The attack exploits an unpatched remote-access gateway, causing significant operational disruption.

fields.label: Paragraph 2
fields.text: Immediate action is critical. We recommend applying the vendor's patch to all remote-access gateways, blocking known attacker IP addresses, and resetting all administrator passwords.

fields.label: Paragraph 3
fields.text: Recovery takes time; maintain offline backups and test restoration procedures. Report any signs of infection to the national cyber incident response team within 6 hours.

fields.label: Bottom line
fields.text: A ransomware group named 'NightLedger' is actively encrypting patient-record and billing systems at 42 hospitals across five states, posing a high-severity threat to critical healthcare infrastructure.

fields.label: Key point 1
fields.text: The attack exploits an unpatched remote-access gateway, first exploited on 22 September 2026.

fields.label: Key point 2
fields.text: As of 28 September, 42 hospitals in five states reported disruption, with recovery taking an average of 4 days.

fields.label: Key point 3
fields.text: The ransomware demands payment in cryptocurrency within 72 hours and threatens to publish stolen data.

fields.label: Action needed 1
fields.text: Apply the vendor's September patch to every remote-access gateway immediately.

fields.label: Action needed 2
fields.text: Block the attacker IP addresses at the network edge and review connection logs since 22 September.
